text: Anyone seeing checkout-api latency climbing? Grafana looks like a sudden P99 spike.
ALERT [3102] [CRITICAL] [E4] checkout-api P99 latency breach: 3100ms exceeds 2000ms threshold
Acknowledging alert 3102. Checking recent deployment of commit b3c891e (v2.3.9).
Was there any database migration executed with this deploy?
No database migration, just a driver version bump. But connection pool is timing out on socket read.
Rolling back checkout-api to v2.3.8 (commit f1092a4) immediately.
RESOLVED: ALERT [3110] [INFO] checkout-api P99 latency returned to baseline: 98ms
Rollback confirmed effective. Closing INC-2026-000 from September 12.
